decisions.guard_extension: precondition: DistributedOptimizer fp32 master shard views must be detached from autograd (no duplicate grad chain); phase: init
decisions.note: Umbrella structural_integrity resolved to conservation: a non-detached view adds each fp32 gradient contribution twice, violating T07's exactly-once summation.
Boundedness over the gradient value range (fp16 underflow to zero without a scaler); object is not T14's scaling scalar (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-3 zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights policy at zero.Init
decisions.note: Per-parameter dtype/quantization state must equal the designated precision policy, matching T05's tensor-vs-designated-dtype objects.
Restoration_after_reload over a serialized config dataclass, a different object role than T11's training state (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: batched packed documents (batch_size>1) with per-element cu_doc_lens
decisions.note: Extractor's invariance_across_config resolved to index_consistency from the relation statement; per-element document-boundary position fidelity is T16's obligation.
Raw ordering resolved to exclusivity (zero attention mass on future positions); forbidden set is temporal, not packed-doc boundaries, so not T19 plus guards (§2.2, §3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: phase: backward; precondition: sequence parallel with gradient_accumulation_fusion (gathered activation contiguity at fused wgrad entry)
decisions.note: Umbrella structural_integrity resolved to sharding_layout_consistency: tensor layout at kernel entry must match the consuming op's mandated layout.
Missing context_parallel_size factor in per-token loss scaling; CP>1 guard and per-token-loss precondition already permitted in T08.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: parameter-group freeze masking present but freeze mode off
decisions.note: Raw conservation resolved to gradient_flow: witness is exactly T17's grad_norm>0 for trainable params on the active loss path.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: multi-epoch training (max_epochs>1) crossing an epoch boundary mid-run
decisions.note: start_index must reset to 0 at the epoch boundary, exactly T13's loader-bookkeeping reset predicate.

decisions.guard_extension: topology: PP>1; precondition: interleaved pipeline parallelism with param_sync_func set and num_model_chunks >= 3
decisions.note: count_frequency_match of a required per-boundary event: exactly one param-sync launch per microbatch id up to total_num_microbatches fits T26's count(event,b)==1 predicate.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: cumulative FLOPs/speed monitoring across checkpoint restarts
decisions.note: Raw proportionality resolved to monotonicity: the object is the cumulative FLOPs counter T15 names explicitly, violated by per-step overwrite instead of defined-increment accumulation.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: muP coord-check standard-parametrization baseline (infshapes=None) load path
decisions.note: Skipped reset_parameters leaves backend-default near-zero stats, violating T27's init-spec conformance witnessed by parameter std at init.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: skip-step optimizer decision statistic (loss) all-reduced before consumption
decisions.note: The skip-decision statistic is replicated optimizer control state (analogous to T01's loss-scale/overflow state) that must be equal across ranks.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: instance-masked batches under sum-then-allreduce DP loss averaging (kept-token-count weighting)
decisions.note: Raw proportionality maps to value_scaling_consistency via the alias map: per-rank loss must carry the kept-token-count normalization factor.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: sequence-parallel all-to-all head redistribution with num_heads not divisible by seq_world_size
decisions.note: Umbrella structural_integrity resolved via the extraction's own witness: elementwise mismatch against an SP=1 reference run is T03's paired-config signal.

decisions.guard_extension: phase: init; precondition: startup device/backend auto-detection on CUDA-capable hosts; alias: config_runtime_consistency -> config_effectiveness
decisions.note: Effective device placement and distributed mode must equal the launched configuration, T18's configured-vs-effective relation.
Unreduced z-loss metric diverging across ranks; T02 already lists MoE aux-loss/z-loss logging as a permitted precondition.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-2 round_robin_gradients partition-owner bookkeeping aligned with actual reduction destination
decisions.note: Umbrella structural_integrity resolved to conservation (secondary coding): misrouted contributions leave the designated owner's accumulated gradient short of the contribution sum.
count_frequency_match over loader length metadata vs realized batch count; objects differ from T12, T26, and singleton O-021 (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: phase: data_loading; precondition: named data-mix enum resolved to a corpus path; alias: config_honoring -> config_effectiveness
decisions.note: The effective corpus path must equal the user-selected named mix, T18's configured-vs-effective relation.
Promoted with held singleton M-025 (independent incident, same relation + objects: elementwise master/working parameter copy fidelity at sync points, unwitnessable by T05's dtype tag) per §4.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-1/2 contiguous_gradients partial-bucket flush (averaging extent limited to valid elements)
decisions.note: Uninitialized bucket tail mixed into the reduction is T07's no-foreign-bytes clause (padding_region == 0).
Boundedness of router gate scores (strictly positive before log/divide); the object is a gating-probability tensor, not T14's scaling scalar nor D-NEW-67's gradient range (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: sparse-gradient allreduce results written back into param.grad
decisions.note: Dropped write-back means contributions are added zero times, violating T07's exactly-once summation into the parameter's gradient buffer.
